title: 第608章 纪元之末须弥妖庭第607章 天蓬出手软禁羲和
slug: 洪荒开局吞噬十一祖巫
content_zh:
天界七重天，天河横亘虚空，青华帝宫悬浮星海之间，亿万星辰沿着亘古不变的轨迹缓缓流转，万道星光静谧蛰伏，一层淡淡的星海道膜隔绝内外天机，将殿中一切动静隐匿于诸天之外。
玄朔携天蓬、黄眉自东海旸谷踏云归来，三道身影破开星河雾霭，稳稳落于帝宫白玉大殿之内。
此行最大的收获，羲和与九子十二女已然被他悄然封入自身星海大世界深处，层层星辰道纹封锁气息，断绝一切外界推演探查，成为制衡太一最重要的隐秘后手。
诸事安顿妥当之后，青华帝宫再度归于一片沉寂，可一张笼罩洪荒的棋局大网，正借着各方势力的纷争，于无形之中缓缓铺开，暗流潜涌，静待风云激荡。
就在天河星海暗流蛰伏之际，洪荒西方大地，早已掀起翻天覆地的巨变，上古以来延续无数量劫的势力格局，正在被硬生生重塑。
东海之上，新一代妖帝太昊陨落，天地间再无人能够正面阻拦太一的步伐。
此刻的太一执掌河图洛书、万龙图录两大妖族至高气运至宝，更完成界体合一这等逆天道果，一身金乌大道圆满无缺，一身威压横扫四海，已然稳稳凌驾当代所有妖族之上。
太一第一时间与鲲鹏和接引道人三方联手挥师四海，清剿四方割据妖族，为重建新时代妖庭打下稳固根基。
烛龙远走域外虚空，踪迹渺茫；东海新主太昊已然身死道消。四海散落的妖族势力群龙无首，面对重回巅峰的金乌正统，根本没有丝毫抗衡之力。
太一、鲲鹏、接引三大顶尖大能联袂出世，兵锋席卷四海八荒。
太一催动自身圆满的金乌大世界，无边大日道域铺展汪洋之上，金色太阳道焰蒸腾万丈，但凡敢于负隅顽抗的妖族，尽数被烈焰笼罩，道基受太阳真火灼烧，难以运转；
鲲鹏舒展北冥天幕，无边吞噬法则交织成巨大囚笼，封死四海所有水域通道，断绝一切妖族逃亡的去路；
接引道人端坐莲台，无边柔和佛光洒落海面，或以佛法渡化摇摆不定的妖族，或以佛门禁术镇压顽抗之辈，有条不紊收拢散落各处的妖族支流。
短短数日功夫，四海之内大大小小割据自立的妖族势力尽数被肃清。
一众依靠水域生存、自诩龙族的鳞甲族群，要么放下兵器俯首归顺，纳入太一管辖，要么被强行封印道基、禁锢修为，迁移指定地域安置。
持续万古的四海妖族格局一朝终结，整片浩瀚四海彻底归入太一掌控之下。
四海平定，外部阻碍尽数扫除，立庭之事提上日程。三大顶级大能齐聚东海龙宫，共论妖族未来走向。
这场妖族巨变，也让鲲鹏正式现身洪荒诸天。
这位上古妖庭大长老、洪荒速度第一的大能，长久隐匿行踪，极少插手世间纷争，如今坦然展露身形，消息传遍三界。
无数闭关不出的老牌大能纷纷心生忌惮，清楚洪荒格局即将迎来新一轮动荡。

殿内水汽氤氲，东海龙宫明珠流光映照三方身影，众人落座，开始商议新妖庭选址。
起初众人拟定两处地点，其一为东海龙宫，依托四海水域，地利充足；
其二是北冥海，地势险峻，进退自如。谁也未曾料到，鲲鹏略一思索，语出惊人，直接提议将新妖庭中枢设立在佛门圣地须弥山。
此言一出，纵使修持静心佛法、情绪极少起伏的接引道人，也不由得一时语塞，心中哭笑不得，一股无力之感油然而生。
须弥山乃是洪荒亘古佛土，佛门起源祖地，亿万载光阴积累下厚重绵长的佛门气运。
此前罗睺重临洪荒，占据须弥山长久时日，以自身本源魔道气息渗透整座神山，深入地脉岩层，令须弥山深埋霸道凛冽的魔道底蕴。
后来罗睺动身前往混沌，诸天局势动荡，接引抓住千载难逢的机会，暗中派遣自身善尸，强势镇压罗睺留在世间唯一弟子无天，重新夺回须弥山掌控权，想要以此为根基重整灵山佛门道统，积蓄气运，静静等候量劫来临，谋求佛门更进一步。
鲲鹏这一手选址，相当于直接将妖族权力核心扎根佛门祖庭。
自此刻起，万妖汇聚、气运升腾的妖族中枢盘踞须弥山之巅，妖族皇道气运、佛门祥和气运、罗睺遗留的魔道气运三股洪荒顶级气运彼此纠缠、交织共振，再也无法彻底分割。
佛门想要独善其身、置身妖族纷争之外的念想彻底落空，从此妖族与佛门一荣俱荣、一损俱损，因果牢牢捆绑，再也无法撇清干系。
接引端坐莲台，心中五味杂陈，无尽悔意翻涌不休。
当初他权衡利弊，选择与太一、鲲鹏联手，本意是借妖族崛起之势庇护佛门，避开量劫浩劫，保全佛门传承。
可不曾想一步踏错，被鲲鹏巧妙布局，直接将整个佛门绑上妖族战车，往后进退两难，处处受制于人。
奈何如今大势已定，各方盟约缔结，木已成舟，再无反悔回转的余地。
选址敲定，新妖庭顺势破土成型，建制恢弘严谨，诸多规制效仿上古妖庭，重现昔日万妖朝拜的盛况。
吉日选定，须弥山之巅举行大典。太一登临最高帝位，重新披上尘封万古的上古妖皇帝袍，冕旒垂落，金乌道韵充斥天地，正式重登妖皇尊位，执掌诸天万妖生杀权柄，统御汇聚而来的妖族气运，誓要重现上古妖庭睥睨洪荒的无上荣光。
常羲作为上古妖庭天后，执掌太阴本源，与太一相伴渡过无尽岁月，在万众朝拜之下，受册封为妖后，母仪万妖，执掌妖族时序、女眷规制，稳固妖庭内部根基。
接引道人以佛门圣人之尊，位列新妖庭妖尊，与鲲鹏平起平坐，成为妖庭顶层核心，执掌庭内教化礼法、秩序仲裁，平衡各方矛盾。

content_en:
On the seventh level of heaven, the Milky Way stretches across the void, and the Qinghua Emperor Palace floats between the sea of ​​stars. Billions of stars slowly flow along the eternal trajectory. Tens of thousands of starlights are dormant quietly. A thin layer of starry sea membrane isolates the inner and outer heavens, hiding all movements in the palace from the heavens.
Xuan Shuo brought Tian Peng and Huang Mei back from the Yang Valley in the East China Sea, and the three figures broke through the mist of the stars and landed steadily in the White Jade Hall of the Imperial Palace.
The biggest gain of this trip is that Xi He and his nine sons and twelve daughters have been quietly sealed into the depths of his star sea world. Layers of star patterns have blocked their aura, cutting off all outside speculation and exploration, and they have become the most important secret back-up force to check and balance Taiyi.
After everything was settled, the Qinghua Imperial Palace fell into silence again, but a vast chess game network covering the ancient world was slowly spreading out invisibly through the disputes between various forces, with undercurrents surging, waiting for the storm to stir up.
Just as the undercurrent of the Milky Way and the Starry Sea is dormant, the ancient western land has already undergone earth-shaking changes. The power structure that has lasted for countless kalpas since ancient times is being reshaped.
Above the East China Sea, the new generation of Demon Emperor Taihao has fallen, and no one in the world can stop Taiyi's progress.
At this moment, Taiyi is in charge of the two most powerful treasures of the demon clan, Hetu Luoshu and Wanlong Tulu. He has also completed the heaven-defying fruit of unification of realms and bodies. His golden crow path is perfect, and his coercion is sweeping across the world. He is already firmly above all the demon clans in the contemporary era.
Taiyi immediately joined forces with Kunpeng and Taoist Jieyin to march across the world to wipe out the demon tribes separatist from all directions, laying a solid foundation for rebuilding the Demon Court in the new era.
Zhulong traveled far away into the void outside the territory, leaving no trace; Taihao, the new master of the East China Sea, had died. The demon clan forces scattered all over the world are leaderless. Facing the Golden Crow Orthodoxy that has returned to its peak, there is no way to compete.
The three top powers Taiyi, Kunpeng, and Jieyin were born together, and their troops swept across the world.
Taiyi activates the perfect Golden Crow World, the boundless Dao Domain of the Great Sun spreads over the vast ocean, and the golden sun Dao flames are steaming for thousands of miles. All monsters who dare to resist stubbornly are all shrouded in flames, and the Dao base is burned by the true fire of the sun, making it difficult to operate;
Kunpeng stretched out the sky of the North Ming Dynasty, and the boundless devouring laws intertwined into a huge cage, sealing all water channels in the four seas and cutting off the escape of all monsters;
The Taoist leader is sitting on the lotus platform, and the boundless and soft Buddha's light is shining on the sea. He may use Buddhism to sway the wavering monsters, or use Buddhist forbidden techniques to suppress the recalcitrant people, and methodically collect the scattered tributaries of the monsters.
In just a few days, all the self-reliant demon clan forces in the four seas, large and small, were wiped out.
A group of scale-armored people who rely on water for survival and claim to be dragons must either lay down their weapons and surrender and be brought under the jurisdiction of Taiyi, or they may have their Taoist foundations sealed, their cultivation imprisoned, and relocated to designated areas.
Once the eternal pattern of monster clans in the Four Seas came to an end, the entire vast sea was completely under the control of Taiyi.
The world is at peace, all external obstacles have been removed, and the establishment of a court is on the agenda. The three top powers gathered in the East China Sea Dragon Palace to discuss the future direction of the demon clan.
This great change in the demon clan also made Kunpeng officially appear in the ancient world.
This great elder of the ancient Demon Court and the fastest powerful man in the world has hidden his whereabouts for a long time and rarely interfered in the disputes in the world. Now he openly reveals himself and the news spreads throughout the three realms.
Countless veteran experts who have been in seclusion are afraid, knowing that the ancient world is about to usher in a new round of turmoil.
The water vapor in the hall was thick, and the flowing light of the Pearl of the East China Sea Dragon Palace reflected the figures of the three parties. Everyone sat down and began to discuss the location of the new Demon Court.
At first, everyone planned two locations. One was the Dragon Palace in the East China Sea, which relied on the waters of the four seas and had sufficient geographical advantages;
The second is Beiminghai, which has a steep terrain and can advance and retreat freely. No one expected that Kunpeng thought for a moment and made a surprising statement, directly proposing to establish the center of the new demon court in Mount Sumeru, the holy land of Buddhism.
As soon as these words came out, even if he practiced the Dharma of Meditation and rarely had any emotional ups and downs, he wouldI couldn't help but be speechless for a moment, I couldn't laugh or cry in my heart, and a feeling of powerlessness arose spontaneously.
Mount Sumeru is the ancient Buddhist land, the ancestral land of Buddhism, and the profound and long-term destiny of Buddhism accumulated over hundreds of millions of years.
Previously, Rahu returned to the ancient world and occupied Mount Sumeru for a long time. He penetrated the entire sacred mountain with his original demonic aura and penetrated deep into the rock formations, making Mount Sumeru bury the domineering and cruel demonic heritage.
Later, Luohu left for Chaos, and the situation in the heavens was in turmoil. Jie Yin seized this golden opportunity and secretly dispatched his own good corpse to suppress Luohu's only disciple Wutian in the world and regain control of Mount Sumeru. He wanted to use this as a basis to reorganize the Buddhist tradition of Lingshan, accumulate luck, quietly wait for the calamity to come, and seek further progress in Buddhism.
Kunpeng's site selection is equivalent to directly rooting the core of the demon clan's power in the ancestral court of Buddhism.
From this moment on, the center of the demon clan, where thousands of demons gather and their luck rises, is entrenched on the top of Mount Sumeru. The three top strands of ancient destiny, the imperial destiny of the demon clan, the peaceful destiny of Buddhism, and the demonic destiny left by Rahu, are entangled and intertwined with each other and resonate, and can no longer be completely separated.
Buddhism's wish to be alone and stay out of the disputes between the demon clan was completely in vain. From then on, the demon clan and Buddhism both prospered and suffered losses, and the cause and effect were tightly bound, and they could no longer be separated from each other.
Sitting on the lotus platform, Jie Yin felt a mixture of emotions in his heart, filled with endless regrets.
At the beginning, he weighed the pros and cons and chose to join forces with Taiyi and Kunpeng. His original intention was to take advantage of the rise of the demon clan to protect Buddhism, avoid catastrophes, and preserve the inheritance of Buddhism.
But he never thought that he would make a mistake and Kunpeng's clever layout would directly tie the entire Buddhism to the demon chariot. He would be in a dilemma and be controlled by others everywhere.
However, now that the situation has been decided, the covenant between all parties has been concluded, the deal is done, and there is no room for repentance or turning around.
The site selection was finalized, and the new Demon Court took shape. Its structure was grand and rigorous, and many regulations imitated the ancient Demon Court, recreating the grand occasion of worship of thousands of demons in the past.
On an auspicious day, a grand ceremony will be held on the top of Mount Sumeru. Taiyi ascended to the highest throne and once again put on the ancient demon emperor's robe that had been dusted for eternity. His crown fell, and the golden crow charm filled the world. He officially returned to the demon emperor's throne, taking charge of the power of life and death of all demons in the world, controlling the fate of the gathered demon clan, and vowing to recreate the supreme glory of the ancient demon court.
Chang Xi, as the Queen of the Ancient Demon Court, was in charge of the origin of Taiyin, and spent endless years with Taiyi. Under the worship of thousands of people, she was canonized as the Demon Queen, the mother of all demons, in charge of the time order of the demon clan, the regulation of female relatives, and stabilizing the internal foundation of the Demon Court.
With the dignity of a Buddhist saint, Taoist Jieyin is ranked as the Demon Lord of the New Demon Court. He is on an equal footing with Kunpeng and becomes the top core of the Demon Court. He is in charge of teaching etiquette, order and arbitration in the court, and balancing the conflicts between all parties.
